English: Wicker Shrine
A simple sacred place marked by woven wooden idols and offerings, serving as a spiritual heart for the nomads.
Druids Circle
A ring of standing stones where druids gather to perform rites and guide the tribe through wisdom and rituals.
Oak Shelter
A sturdy wooden structure beneath great oaks, offering communal shelter for sacred gatherings and celebrations.
Sacred Spring
A revered spring, encircled by carved stones, where water is believed to carry blessings and purify the tribe.
Blessed Glade
A glade hallowed by ritual, where sacred fires are kept burning and tribes gather for great ceremonies.
Spirit Stand
A series of monumental totems and carved stones, channeling the spirits of ancestors and the land itself.
Sanctified Grove
A revered grove enclosed by sacred trees, guarded by a druidic order and reserved for the most important rites.
Druids Pavilion
A large, elaborately decorated tent where the chief druid presides over the tribes spiritual matters and preserves sacred knowledge.
Holy Oak Hall
A grand timber hall built around a mighty oak, serving as the spiritual and administrative center for the tribes faith.
Celtic Sacred Sanctuary
A vast, hallowed sanctuary of stone and living trees, the ultimate center of Celtic spirituality, unity, and tradition for the nomadic tribe.
